idiomatic: That night white vapor like silk descended from heaven.

idiomatic: On gengzi day of the sixth month posthumous title Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor; temple name Daozong.

literal: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.
idiomatic: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.

literal: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.
idiomatic: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.

literal: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.
idiomatic: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.

literal: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.
idiomatic: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.

literal: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.
idiomatic: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.

literal: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.
idiomatic: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.

literal: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?
idiomatic: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?
